_meta.source: World Bank Real-Time Food Prices (RTFP) via HDX
_meta.notes: Year-on-year food price inflation from the World Bank Real-Time Food Prices index, distributed via HDX (CC BY 4.0). One row per country: the MEDIAN of inflation_food_price_index across that country's markets at that country's own latest reporting month — median, not mean, because market-level price series carry outliers a single blown-out market must not be allowed to set. Every row's as_of is a real date read from the source's DATES column. Coverage is 37 crisis-exposed countries (as_of 2026-08-01). This does NOT replace FAOSTAT globally — FAOSTAT still carries the other ~125 countries, and RTFP is simply the better source where it exists. RTFP is a market-basket price index, not a national CPI food component: it is measured where humanitarian monitoring runs, so it reflects the markets poor households actually buy in, and it is not directly comparable with a FAOSTAT consumer price index.
